title: Scale & Rotate
definition: Specific transform utilities used to enlarge/shrink an element (`scale`) or spin it around its center point (`rotate`).
simpleExplanation:
- `scale-110` makes it 10% larger.
- `scale-90` makes it 10% smaller.
- `rotate-45` tilts it exactly 45 degrees clockwise.
realWorldExample: Creating an accordion chevron icon `<svg>` that rotates 180 degrees (`rotate-180`) to point downwards when the accordion is opened.

basic: What Tailwind class makes an element grow exactly twice its original size?
intermediate: If you scale an element up to `scale-150`, does it push the elements next to it away to make room?

answers.question: Push elements away?
answers.answer: No. Transforms do not affect document flow. The scaled element will visually overlap the elements next to it.
